location_rules.barcelona: allowed ONLY if the employing legal entity is non-Spanish
location_rules.why: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires a NON-SPANISH employer. A Barcelona role employed via a Spanish entity breaks visa eligibility outright. If the entity isn't clear from the listing, flag it - never silently include or silently drop it.

compensation_floor.rule: include if unstated; include if above floor; exclude only if a stated figure is clearly and substantially below it
compensation_floor.note: Left blank in the committed version - this is a real negotiating position, not something to publish. Set your own numbers in a local, uncommitted edit.

notes_for_editing: This file is the whole point of extending the agent without touching code. Add/remove sources, adjust the comp floor, or add new role titles here.
